title: MVP V4-1 policy RFC freeze
mvp_checklist: docs/CONCEPT_ROADMAP.md MVP V4 — Policy Engine Runtime
brief: Freeze the implementable MVP V4 policy contract before product-code slices: dedicated PolicyTx/PolicyActionTx instead of zero-PWM self-transfer, activation lifecycle, hybrid corporate INIT metadata/rescue address, emergency routing finalization, and additive policy reject codes.

delegations.prompt_summary: Independent review of V4-1 doc-only RFC freeze across RFC 6/7/14, roadmap, mvp_v4 plan, and task traceability.

notes: Owner decisions: use dedicated PolicyTx with embedded PolicyAction and keep normal self-transfer rejected; INIT metadata uses hybrid on-chain short public fields plus commitment for long/mutable text. PASS_WITH_NITS review mechanical nits were auto-closed: roadmap no longer defers INIT format to a future RFC/ADR, naming is aligned to routing.emergency_redirect / PolicyTx+PolicyAction, and RFC 7 states decimal-string JSON/API encoding for PolicyTx fee u128. Product code changes in later sprints must go through pwm-coding -> pwm-testing -> pwm-review.
